rows.contract: Preserve renderer preference and numeric device persistence and valid fallback when the requested graphics API is not in the build.
rows.native_mapping: Use the normalized Settings API under Metal. Migrate explicitly unsupported stored API to native; reset a device ordinal from that source API only when the same scope owns it. Preserve Software, approved native ordinals and inherited defaults.
rows.expected_result: Real old config without Spatial, legacy default migration, native round trip and independently overriding/inheriting device and renderer.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt INI native/off compile, migration from legacy raw API values, default-off Spatial, persisted native index, global and per-game override/unset, debug flag persistence, independent filter/resolution, PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Switchable settings serialize global default and local override metadata, including blank legacy key behavior.
rows.native_mapping: Read and write the independent MetalFX Spatial preference with current generic templates. Leave guest filtering, asynchronous compilation and cached shader fields unchanged.
rows.expected_result: INI persistence with global default false, enabled and disabled local overrides, inherit and reload, old file no setting and independent guest sampler or renderer config.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt INI native/off compile, migration from legacy raw API values, default-off Spatial, persisted native index, global and per-game override/unset, debug flag persistence, independent filter/resolution, PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: The shared Qt settings loader already reads both optional validation and command capture preferences.
rows.native_mapping: Native-only write back the previously read dump_command_buffers flag, preserving independent renderer_debug and logging options.
rows.expected_result: Global explicit true and false both survive reload using real INI key flow; per-game config cannot overwrite global diagnostics.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt INI native/off compile, migration from legacy raw API values, default-off Spatial, persisted native index, global and per-game override/unset, debug flag persistence, independent filter/resolution, PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Save the globally owned value even while an override is active during native title startup.
rows.native_mapping: Write through the existing basic serializer with the global value when a local override is active, without changing stored in-memory preference ownership.
rows.expected_result: Real QSettings asserts global Spatial stays enabled while a per-game override is disabled during concurrent same-process Save calls.
rows.actual_result: Regression reproduced before repair. Real QSettings global-active-title save, local override, native/off compilation, PICA and CTest retested.
